description: Hydrographie de la CCPOP_Canaux irrigation is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Orange en Provence. Irrigation channels (Canal de Carpentras side Jonquières and Canal de Pierrelatte and a management by the ASA of the Meyne to Orange and Caderousse ) composing the hydrographic network of the CCPOP, formed by a set of linear elements of water flow of very variable importance. More information on the CCPOP website:. Coverage: Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Orange en Provence. The portal shows the English title as "Hydrography of the CCPOP_Irrigation Channels" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes du Pays d'Orange en Provence. Its keywords include source, irrigation, canal, eau, hydrographie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
